verdict.rationale: Omnara supports connecting MCP servers to agent configs, explicitly naming Linear as an example integration, meaning issue-tracker connectivity is technically possible via the generic MCP mechanism, but no dedicated Jira, ClickUp, or Monday.com integrations are documented or demonstrated. missing for 10: explicit Jira/ClickUp/Monday.com connectors, evidence of ticket-management workflows (create/update tickets) beyond generic tool discovery, and any hands-on confirmation of issue-tracker use.
